text: LumenDesk offers three plans: Starter at $19 per user per month, Team at $49 per user per month, and Enterprise with custom pricing. All plans include unlimited tickets and email support.
title: Plans and pricing overview

text: The Team plan costs $49 per user per month when billed annually, or $59 per user per month when billed monthly. It adds automations, custom SLAs, and priority support.
title: Team plan details

text: The Enterprise plan uses custom pricing based on seat count and volume. It includes a dedicated success manager, a 99.99% uptime SLA, and single sign-on.
title: Enterprise plan

text: Automations in LumenDesk let teams route tickets, send replies, and escalate stale conversations automatically. Automations are available on the Team and Enterprise plans only.
title: Automations

text: AI triage classifies incoming tickets by intent and urgency using a fine-tuned language model. It suggests a reply draft and a priority level for every ticket.
title: AI triage

text: The knowledge base lets you publish help articles and deflect common questions. Articles support versioning, search analytics, and multilingual content.
title: Knowledge base

text: The live chat widget can be embedded on any website with one snippet of JavaScript. It supports canned responses, file attachments, and offline messages.
title: Live chat widget

text: Reporting includes first response time, resolution time, CSAT, and agent workload. Reports can be exported as CSV or scheduled by email weekly.
title: Reporting and analytics

text: The Slack integration posts ticket updates to a channel and lets agents reply from Slack. It requires the Team plan or higher.
title: Slack integration

text: The Salesforce integration syncs customer records and ticket history between LumenDesk and Salesforce. It is available on the Enterprise plan.
title: Salesforce integration

text: The public API supports tickets, users, and comments over REST with OAuth 2.0. Webhooks fire on ticket created, ticket updated, and ticket solved events.
title: API and webhooks

text: LumenDesk is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. Data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256.
title: Security and compliance

text: Single sign-on supports SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect. SSO is available on the Enterprise plan and requires a verified company domain.
title: Single sign-on

text: Ticket data is retained for 7 years by default on Enterprise, and 2 years on Starter and Team. Customers can request an export or deletion at any time.
title: Data retention

text: Support is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week on the Team and Enterprise plans. Starter customers get email support during business hours, 9am to 5pm Pacific.
title: Support hours

text: The Team plan includes a 4-hour first response SLA for urgent tickets. Enterprise customers get a 1-hour first response SLA and a 99.99% uptime SLA.
title: Service level agreements

text: Getting started takes about 15 minutes: create a workspace, invite agents, connect an email inbox, and import existing tickets from a CSV file.
title: Getting started

text: Migration from Zendesk or Freshdesk is free on all plans. The importer preserves ticket history, comments, and attachments.
title: Migrating from another tool

text: The Starter plan allows up to 10 agents and 5,000 tickets per month. The Team plan allows up to 100 agents with unlimited tickets.
title: Plan limits

text: Billing is monthly or annual. Annual billing saves 17 percent compared to monthly billing. Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase.
title: Billing and refunds
